title: Résumé Profile
description: Selection and presentation for one résumé variant. A profile references the canonical career record by id only. It must NOT introduce new employers, new metrics, or free-form replacement bullet text; every displayed string is chosen from the canonical document via ids.

label.description: Human-readable name for this profile (e.g. 'AI Product Design Lead — public').

length_budget.description: Maximum number of claim bullets to render across the whole résumé (a bullet cap, not a page count). Role and skill selection should respect this ceiling.

emphasis.description: Emphasis tags this profile prioritizes; matched against claim.emphasis in the canonical record.

headline_id.description: Id of an entry in identity.headline_variants[] to render as the headline.

summary_id.description: Id of an entry in identity.summary_variants[] to render as the personal summary.

email_id.description: Id of an entry in identity.emails[] to render as the contact email.

phone_id.description: Id of an entry in identity.phones[] to render as the contact phone.

location_id.description: Id of an entry in identity.locations[] to render as the location.

allow_unverified.description: When false, export must exclude any claim whose status is not 'verified'. The public profile sets this to false.

roles.description: Included roles in display order. Only role_ids and claim_ids/variant_ids that exist in the canonical record are valid.

required_role_ids.description: Role ids that MUST be present in the export; the builder fails if any is missing from the canonical record or from roles[].

skill_priority.description: Ordered list of skill names or ids to surface first. References existing skills only.

tone.description: Guidance string for voice/wording selection (e.g. 'confident, concise, outcome-first').

claim_id.description: Id of a claim that exists on the referenced role in the canonical record.

variant_id.description: Id of an approved wording variant to use instead of the canonical claim text. Must exist on the claim; no free-form text is allowed here.

role_id.description: Id of a role in the canonical record.

title_variant_id.description: Optional approved title variant id to display for this role.

summary_level.description: Which role summary to render, if any.

claims.description: Claims to include for this role, in display order. Each references an existing claim id and optional approved variant id.
